name: Whisper of the Sands (Immanence of Set, Basic)

system.description:
The shared blood of Set that sings in the veins of all Setites creates a bond allowing a Serpent to communicate his thoughts to his servants and childer, no matter how far away they are. This power lets the sorcerer share news and set plans in motion from hundreds of leagues away.

System: The player spends a Blood Trait and wins a Manipulation + Leadership test (difficulty six Traits). If successful, the vampire may communicate with any of his progeny or ghouls regardless of distance; each success lets one target receive the message, though all targets receive the same one. The communication lasts one turn and no more than two short sentences; the player may maintain the link for further exchanges by spending a Willpower Trait each additional turn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
